verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents official companion apps beyond messaging channels: Windows Hub, a macOS menu bar app with native tabs and a widget panel, a Linux app, iOS/watchOS/Android mobile nodes, and a browser Control UI for config editing and MCP server management. It also offers a Telegram Mini App and lets remote clients continue Gateway conversations by URL, so these surfaces go beyond basic chat. missing for 10: explicit documentation of feature parity across the apps, evidence that the mobile apps are full assistant clients rather than device-capability nodes, independent or hands-on corroboration of the app experience.
